name: Habitas Tulum
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary seamlessly blends bohemian luxury with ancient Mayan mystique, where cenotes meet Caribbean shores and wellness rituals honor indigenous traditions.
whats_special: Habitas Tulum sits on pristine white sand beaches within the UNESCO World Heritage Sian Ka'an Biosphere Reserve, home to over 300 bird species and ancient Mayan ruins. The property features safari-style tents elevated on stilts, offering unobstructed jungle-to-ocean views while protecting the fragile coastal ecosystem below.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the overwater spa during full moon nights - the combination of moonlight reflecting off the Caribbean and traditional Mayan healing ceremonies creates an otherworldly experience you won't find anywhere else.
dont_miss: The nearby Tulum Archaeological Site perched dramatically on 40-foot cliffs overlooking the sea - it's one of the last cities built by the Maya and the only major Mayan site located directly on the coast. Also explore the hidden cenotes (natural sinkholes) within minutes of the property, considered sacred portals to the underworld by ancient Maya.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with direct access to pristine Caribbean waters
Eco-conscious design with sustainable bamboo construction and solar power
Vibrant community atmosphere with wellness programs and cultural experiences
Unique glamping-style accommodations blending luxury with nature immersion
cons: Open-air design may expose rooms to natural elements and wildlife
Remote jungle location requires planning for transportation and accessibility
